what: Plan adds final-bail-reason write only to refresh-run-logs pre-push path
scenario_or_breakage: final-bail-reason.txt is rebuilt in Step 18 by restore-finalize-state.sh after ship-pr exits 3/4, but Step 18 does not invoke refresh-run-logs.sh or any larch-log write/commit before teardown, so the proposed batch remains absent from committed larch-logs on the bail path it is meant to preserve
suggested_fix: Add a terminal pre-teardown write/commit after restore-finalize-state.sh and before implement-finalize.sh teardown, or call refresh-run-logs.sh there with the existing post-merge and no-logs guards; keep the [ -f ] guard and 2>/dev/null || true failure tolerance
